records.title: BLU MQTT Gateway
records.body:
# BLU MQTT Gateway

## Purpose

On a Shelly Gen 2/3 (scripting + BLE), continuously scan BLE, decode **BTHome v2** (Shelly BLU) and **Minew S4** packets for a MAC whitelist, and publish status to MQTT for Giano Supervisor / GFP consumers.

Code: `shelly-blu-mqtt-gateway.js` · ops: `shelly-blu-mqtt-gateway-README.md`.

## Flow

1. Script starts; reads device MQTT topic prefix / connection state.
2. BLE scan runs; packets filtered by whitelist MAC.
3. Decode BTHome object IDs (battery, window, motion, button, temp/humidity, …) or Minew S4.
4. Publish to `gfplab/ble/<type>-<mac>/status` (under device topic prefix conventions).
5. Whitelist updates via **KVS** (`gfp.ble.wl.<name>`) or MQTT config on `<topic_prefix>/gfplab/config`.

## Triggers

- Shelly Script “Run on startup” + Start
- Incoming BLE advertisements
- MQTT config messages / KVS sets for whitelist
- Optional timer re-publish (`ENABLE_TIMER_PUBLISH`, `TIMER_PERIOD_MS`)

## Dependencies

- MQTT configured on the Shelly
- BLE capable Gen 2/3 firmware with scripting
- Whitelist entries (empty whitelist → no publishes of interest)

## Tunables (in-script)

| Variable | Role |
|----------|------|
| `DEBUG_ENABLED` / `DEBUG_UNKNOWN_MAC` | Logging |
| `USE_EVENTS` | Event-based publish (slower) |
| `MQTT_QOS` / `MQTT_RETAIN` | Publish flags |
| `ENABLE_TIMER_PUBLISH` | Periodic cache republish |

## Edge cases

- Unknown MACs logged once only if `DEBUG_UNKNOWN_MAC`
- Derived from Allterco BLU examples; keep decode tables aligned when new BLU object IDs appear

## Related

[[overview]] · [[Tools-vs-Scripts]] — host tools can discover BLU SSIDs/names but do not run this gateway.

records.title: LoRa Relay
records.body:
# LoRa Relay

## Purpose

Pair of **experimental** scripts for Shelly **1 Gen 4** (LoRa add-on): control a remote relay over **868 MHz LoRa** with no Wi-Fi or cloud.

| Device role | File |
|-------------|------|
| TX (local switch / button) | `shelly-lora-relay-tx.js` |
| RX (remote load) | `shelly-lora-relay-rx.js` |

Ops: `shelly-lora-relay-README.md`.

## Flow — TX 3-phase ON cycle

On each TX switch **ON** press, a cyclic phase advances:

| ON press # | Phase | TX local | RX remote |
|------------|-------|----------|-----------|
| 1 | 1/3 | ON | OFF |
| 2 | 2/3 | ON | OFF |
| 3 | 3/3 | ON | **ON** |

TX **OFF** always sends RX=OFF. Payload is Base64 JSON via `LoRa.SendBytes`:

`{ t: "relay", on, phase, onCount, reason }` (`tx_on` / `tx_off`).

## Flow — RX

1. LoRa event handler decodes Base64 → JSON.
2. If `t === "relay"`, calls `Switch.Set` with `on`.
3. Logs RSSI for field debug.

## Triggers

- TX: `switch:N` toggle events; boot reads current output
- RX: LoRa component events for matching `LORA_ID`
- Deploy: upload both scripts, Run on startup, enable LoRa add-on (`LoRa.SetConfig`)

## Dependencies

- 2× Gen 4 with LoRa support; identical `LORA_ID` (default `100`)
- `SWITCH_ID` (default `0`) on each device
- LoRa range / antennas; busy TX skips rapid toggles (`[TX] skip busy`)

## Edge cases

- Mismatched LoRa IDs → no RX
- Very low RSSI (< -120 dBm) → move closer / antenna
- Status experimental — validate before production sites

## Related

[[overview]] · [[Tools-vs-Scripts]]

records.title: Tools vs Scripts
records.body:
# Tools vs Scripts

| | **gfplab-shelly-scripts** (this repo) | **gfplab-shelly-tools** |
|--|--------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| Runs on | Shelly device scripting engine | Operator PC / Docker / Electron |
| Language | Shelly Script (device JS) | Node.js |
| Job | [[BLU-MQTT-Gateway]], [[LoRa-Relay]] | Discover + P-Touch labels |
| Deploy | Paste into device Scripts UI | `npm` / Docker / pkg |
| MCP wiki | `llm-wiki-gfplab-shelly-scripts` | `llm-wiki-gfplab-shelly-tools` |

**Complementary lifecycle:** label and identify with **tools** at commission time; run **scripts** on the installed device for MQTT bridging or LoRa control.

No shared npm package. Domain overlap: Shelly BLU naming and MQTT topics consumed by Giano / GFP stack.

See [[overview]].

records.title: Overview — gfplab-shelly-scripts
records.body:
# Overview — gfplab-shelly-scripts

Collection of **on-device Shelly Scripts** (Gen 2/3/4) that run inside the Shelly scripting engine for GFP Lab field behaviour.

## What this repo is / is not

| Is | Is not |
|----|--------|
| JS uploaded to Shelly **Scripts** UI | Host Node.js discovery/label tools |
| Runtime BLE→MQTT and LoRa relay logic | Firmware patches |
| Ops READMEs next to each script | A deploy pipeline / npm package |

Sibling host tooling: **gfplab-shelly-tools** — see [[Tools-vs-Scripts]].

## Purpose

Provide maintainable, versioned scripts for:

1. Bridging Shelly BLU / BTHome (and Minew S4) sensors into MQTT for Giano Supervisor / GFP stack
2. Controlling a remote relay over LoRa without Wi-Fi/cloud (Gen 4 + LoRa add-on)

## Scripts

| Script | Status (in-file) | Wiki |
|--------|------------------|------|
| `shelly-blu-mqtt-gateway.js` | production | [[BLU-MQTT-Gateway]] |
| `shelly-lora-relay-tx.js` | experimental | [[LoRa-Relay]] |
| `shelly-lora-relay-rx.js` | experimental | [[LoRa-Relay]] |

Operator docs in git: `shelly-blu-mqtt-gateway-README.md`, `shelly-lora-relay-README.md`, root `README.md`.

## Flow (deploy)

1. Ensure device Gen / firmware supports scripting (and LoRa add-on for relay pair).
2. Configure MQTT (gateway) or LoRa IDs (relay) on the device.
3. Paste script into Shelly web UI → Scripts; enable **Run on startup**; start.
4. Configure whitelist (gateway) or verify TX/RX logs (relay).

## Triggers

- Device boot (Run on startup)
- BLE advertisements / MQTT config topics ([[BLU-MQTT-Gateway]])
- Local switch toggle / LoRa RX events ([[LoRa-Relay]])

## Dependencies

- Shelly Gen 2+ (BLE/MQTT gateway) or Gen 4 with LoRa (relay)
- Scripting enabled; MQTT broker reachable for gateway
- Matching `LORA_ID` on TX and RX for LoRa pair

## Related

- Host tools wiki: MCP `llm-wiki-gfplab-shelly-tools`
- Agent entry: `llms.txt`, [[current-focus]]
